title: Bug receipt ({testCasesDir}/bugs/<id>-receipt.json)
description: Written by /file-bug after a bug is filed (or saved, for `none`). The record of what was filed and how it was verified.

createdId.description: issue key / work item id / task id / issue number / saved file path

reproduced.description: false if reproduction failed or was skipped and the user chose to file anyway

commentedOnExisting.description: true when the report was added as a comment on an existing issue instead of filing a new one
